name: evo-front
description: Angular библиотека автоматизации работы frontend разработчика
author: Кургузов Владимир Геннадьевич <kurguzov74@gmail.com>

scripts.LIB-TO-NPM-PATCH: npm run _delete-build && npm run _version-patch && npm run _copy-publish
scripts.LIB-TO-NPM-MINOR: npm run _delete-build && npm run _version-minor && npm run _copy-publish
scripts.LIB-TO-NPM-MAJOR: npm run _delete-build && npm run _version-major && npm run _copy-publish
scripts._delete: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); if (fs.existsSync('dist')) fs.rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });"
scripts._copy: node -e "const fs = require('fs'); fs.mkdirSync('dist', { recursive: true }); const pkg = fs.readFileSync('package.json'); fs.writeFileSync('dist/package.json', pkg); if (fs.existsSync('README.md')) fs.copyFileSync('README.md', 'dist/README.md'); if (fs.existsSync('LICENSE')) fs.copyFileSync('LICENSE', 'dist/LICENSE');"
scripts._copy-publish: npm run _copy && cd dist && npm publish --tag ng16-17
